data.title: Sporting CP vs Manchester United Prediction, Tips and Odds | Champions League
data.content:
### Manchester United team news

Matheus Cunha is suspended for one match after a second yellow card against Roma, which costs United their top scorer in the league phase, with three goals.

Leny Yoro was sent off at Liverpool, but his Premier League suspension does not apply in Europe, so he is available.

Benjamin Sesko (calf), Manuel Ugarte (cruciate ligament) and Carlos Baleba (hamstring) are all unavailable, and Ugarte faces a long-term lay-off. [...] Fonseca kept the back four of Ivan Fresneda, Eduardo Quaresma, Goncalo Inacio and Maxi Araujo for his Liga Portugal debut, and that line is expected to start again.

Luis Suarez leads the attack after scoring in three of his four Champions League appearances, including twice against LASK.

#### Sporting CP predicted lineup vs Manchester United

Sporting CP predicted XI (4-3-3): Silva; Fresneda, Quaresma, Inacio, Araujo; Andersen, Altimira, Doumbia; Catamo, Suarez, Irankunda [...] Fonseca has all of Sporting's internationals back from the break, and Flavio Goncalves and Fotis Ioannidis trained on 22 November after a knee knock and thigh discomfort respectively.

Nuno Santos is out with a muscle injury, while Zeno Debast has not played since 19 September and looks unlikely to feature.

Rui Silva is expected in goal after starting the 1-0 win at Shakhtar Donetsk and the Taca de Portugal tie, although Kaique Pereira played in the league win over Moreirense.
